# AI Blog Capstone

A simple blog website that lets visitors browse published posts and lets an admin create new blogs with AI-generated summaries.

## Features
- Blog list with article cards
- Full blog detail view
- Admin form to create a title and content
- Generate Summary action
- Summary saved alongside each article
- Responsive layout for desktop and mobile screens

## Run locally
1. Install dependencies:
   npm install
2. Start the app:
   npm start
3. Open http://localhost:3000 in your browser.

## Project structure
- server.js — Express server
- public/index.html — application layout
- public/styles.css — responsive design
- public/app.js — blog rendering and logic
